name: Mizano
sources: @Cron / BullMQ jobs (recurring journals, depreciation, notifications, intake worker, AI schedulers)
gh issue list + milestones (MVP — Ship plan → 20 Nov, Post-launch)

features.notes: Form login + NextAuth + JWT refresh rotation; the auth endpoints are throttled to 5 requests/minute per handler, the suite rations logins accordingly.
POST /auth/register creates the organization, its Admin role and the first user.
Anonymous visitors of / are redirected here.
KPI cards + ~40 widget endpoints under /reports/dashboard/*.

name.ar: العربية والإنجليزية والاتجاه من اليمين لليسار

features.notes: Several pages (composite items, movements, trial balance page, general ledger page, my tasks) hard-code English titles: only their direction is asserted in Arabic.
Sidebar, header, breadcrumbs, shared UI building blocks; also robots.txt / sitemap.xml and the protected-route middleware behaviour.
Approval posts one balanced journal exactly once (atomic and idempotent); the midnight overdue sweep (BillsService.markOverdueBills) has no HTTP hook.
Upload step and stepper are tested in the browser; scanned images need the OCR service (off in the verify stack). The confirm step (draft bill with exact totals) is covered at API level.

name.en: Journal entries and the posted ledger

features.notes: Double entry, immutability of posted history, single reversal, period lock date.
The midnight @Cron has no HTTP hook; the same idempotent posting runs through POST /recurring-profiles/:id/execute, which the test drives.
No page uses the wizard yet (only the hooks); the API wizard and the opening balance journal are tested.
VAT/e-invoicing: the repo has no ETA / ZATCA adapter (issues #27-#30 are closed as 'Later'); VAT returns, settlement journals and payments are what exists.
The cron and POST /assets/depreciation/run call the same runMonthlyDepreciation(organization).
Payroll is computed with JS floats and its journal bypasses JournalsService (issue #130).
Completion consumes components, delivers finished goods and posts a COGM journal.
Rendered by headless Chromium (puppeteer).
Includes the ledger lock date (period locks) and the default accounts every posting uses.

features.entry: NotificationsService @Cron (hourly overdue invoices, 08:00 low stock, 09:00 bills due)
features.blocked: cron-only: the hourly/daily jobs have no HTTP or test hook in the verify stack; their inputs (overdue invoice in the aging report) are asserted instead

features.notes: PDFs are rendered by headless Chromium; sending needs SMTP settings (off in the verify stack).
The controller only exposes status/SSE of a job; no endpoint starts one (each module has its own per-record bulk-* routes).

answers need Ollama (off in the verify stack); the widget and the graceful 'unavailable' contract are tested
a run scrapes external web sources and reads the repository (outbound network, off in the verify stack); only the page, job history and validation are tested
LLM explanations need Ollama (off in the verify stack); the rule/statistics based reads and the empty-state contract are tested
